title: Hadiah Galakan ke IPT (Higher Education Encouragement Award)
description:
Annual financial assistance of RM800 for eligible Sarawakian higher education students.
Supports students during their transition into tertiary education.
Separate from recurring monthly allowances and education loans.
amount_note: RM800 per year. Paid once annually: August for new students; April for continuing students, according to the supplied payment notice.
deadline_note: The 2026 intake is closed. The next application period is July–August 2027. Exact opening and closing dates have not been provided.
payment_information:
Payment arrangements
The approved student list is sent to Bank Simpanan Nasional (BSN) for BSN account opening.
Students must visit BSN to verify and activate their account before the bank card is handed over.
Payment is made once per year: RM800 in August for new students and April for continuing students.
eligibility_note: The original PDF limits eligibility to first-time enrolment, while the supplied payment notice also mentions continuing students. Confirm renewal eligibility with Yayasan Sarawak.
source: User-provided payment notice screenshot and application-period update, 19 November 2026. The notice specifies August for new students and April for continuing students.
